A double-breasted midnight-navy naval frock coat with twin rows of anchor-stamped brass buttons and gold-rope epaulets, over a white high-collar linen shirt and charcoal waistcoat, grey breeches tucked into polished knee-boots, a broad brass-buckled sword-belt, leather flight-goggles pushed up on his brow.

An oxblood leather flight greatcoat with five copper turn-buckle clasps and a hammered-brass pauldron, over a cream cotton shirt and dark leather waistcoat, heavy twill trousers tucked into laced flight-boots, a brass-shell bandolier crossing his chest, one articulated brass gauntlet on his left hand.

A sky-corsair longcoat of salt-scarred dark-brown leather over a loose ivory linen shirt and a broad leather baldric, a brass-buckled crimson sash through which a cutlass rides, canvas trousers tucked into mismatched cuffed boots, fingerless gauntlets, a battered tricorn bearing a tarnished brass cockade.

A fitted gunmetal-grey wool officer tunic with a high gear-embroidered collar and brass toggle-buttons, over a white collarband shirt, dark breeches and mirror-polished knee-boots, a leather cross-belt carrying a brass spyglass and holstered pistol, brass-rimmed goggles hanging on a fine copper chain.

A deep-crimson Mughal-cut sky-officer achkan with gold-zardozi cuffs and brass-and-carnelian buttons, over a fine white cotton shirt and fitted leather waistcoat, churidar trousers tucked into embroidered ankle-boots, a broad brass-and-enamel dress-belt, a scimitar riding a jeweled leather scabbard at his hip.

A waxed-canvas hip-length flight jacket with brass turn-buckle closures, over a grey high-collar wool shirt and a riveted leather chest-harness, heavy twill trousers tucked into cuffed engineer-boots, a map-satchel on a brass-buckled shoulder-strap, copper-riveted leather elbow-patches, brass-rimmed aviator goggles on his forehead.

A Persian sky-corsair caftan-coat of teal-and-gold brocade with brass filigree clasps, worn open over an ivory collarband linen shirt and a fitted leather waistcoat, wide shalwar trousers tucked into heeled leather boots, a copper-studded baldric carrying a curved talwar, brass compass on a leather fob.

A charcoal wool riding-coat with velvet collar-facings and brass frog-closures, over a buff waistcoat and a white stock-cravat of folded linen, tan breeches tucked into tall riding-boots with brass spur-caps, a leather shoulder-holster with brass-frame revolver, copper-buckled gloves folded through his belt.

A Tokyo airship-academy uniform of indigo wool — a high Mandarin-collar tunic with brass chrysanthemum buttons and rank-embroidered sleeve-bands — over a white cotton undershirt, straight hakama-cut trousers tucked into lacquered leather boots, a gear-worked brass rank-badge on a leather lanyard, riveted leather wrist-guards.

A long storm-grey oilskin duster with brass grommet-eyelets and a caped shoulder, over a rust-brown wool shirt and a buckled leather waistcoat, canvas trousers tucked into heavy engineer-boots, a full-width brass-buckled belt, a leather bandolier carrying signal-flares in brass-capped cylinders across his torso.

A bottle-green wool naval frock coat with copper-wire frogging and a split skirt, over a pale-gold silk waistcoat and white high-collar shirt, cream breeches tucked into polished Hessian boots with tasseled brass ferrules, a leather sword-knot at his wrist, brass-framed monocle on a copper chain.

A Mughal sky-navigator's deep-saffron sherwani-coat with intricate brass-thread kantha embroidery and onyx-capped brass buttons, over a white cotton collarband shirt, churidar trousers tucked into caramel leather ankle-boots, a wide brass-and-silk waistband-sash, a leather map-tube slung on a brass-ring shoulder-strap.

A black-leather sky-pirate longcoat with scored brass buckle-straps at the waist and cuffs, over a slate-blue wool turtleneck sweater and a riveted chest-harness of brown leather, heavy twill trousers tucked into buckle-strap flight-boots, a cutlass on a wide brass-ring baldric, a brass-skulled walking-staff as boarding-weapon.

A rust-red canvas flight suit with a double row of brass press-studs and reinforced leather knee-panels, worn under an open short waist-jacket of oiled leather with copper rivet-trim, tucked into buckled calf-boots, a full chest-and-shoulder harness with four brass D-rings, aviator goggles on a woven-leather strap.

A slate-wool Victorian frock coat with braid-trimmed lapels and two brass fob-pockets, over a white pin-tucked linen shirt and a pewter-silk waistcoat, charcoal breeches tucked into spit-polished knee-boots, a leather dispatch-satchel on a brass-slide shoulder-strap, copper-rimmed goggles pushed to his hat-brim.

An Ottoman sky-officer dolman jacket of midnight-blue wool with dense gold-cord soutache and brass lion-head buttons, over a white collarband shirt, red çakşır trousers tucked into pointed leather boots, a wide brass-and-enamel kemer-belt carrying a yatagan in a brass-tipped scabbard, leather wrist-guards with copper studs.

A weathered brown leather pirate-captain coat, three-quarter length with split tails and hammered-brass coat-hooks, over a heavy ivory linen shirt and a leather waistcoat with six brass coin-buttons, canvas trousers tucked into mismatched cuffed boots, a boarding-axe on a baldric, battered brass compass in his breast-pocket.

A deep-burgundy wool cavalry-cut longcoat with a double-breasted brass-button front and a wide back-vent, over a white high-collar shirt and a charcoal waistcoat, breeches tucked into tall boots with brass spur-straps, a leather cross-belt and brass pistol-holster, copper-wire rank-loops on each shoulder-board.

A waxed-linen short flight-jacket in khaki with turned-back cuffs exposing copper-rivet trim, over a cream collarband shirt and a dark-wool ribbed waistcoat, heavy canvas trousers tucked into ankle-boots with four brass buckle-straps, a full leather-and-brass navigation-harness carrying a slide-rule in a copper-tipped case.

A Korean sky-captain's deep-teal gungbok-style longcoat with brass cloud-pattern clasp-buttons and wide satin-faced lapels, over a white banded-collar cotton shirt and a fitted leather waistcoat, straight trousers tucked into polished ankle-boots, a broad brass-and-leather officer's belt, a lacquered wooden signal-pistol holstered at his hip.

A forest-green broadcloth shooting-coat with leather-faced shoulder-patches and brass cartridge-loops along the breast, over a cream flannel shirt and a moss-wool waistcoat, cord breeches tucked into lace-up field-boots, a brass-buckled game-bag converted to a navigator's satchel, copper-rimmed wind-goggles on a woven strap.

An ivory linen tropical-weight sky-officer jacket with standing collar, brass anchor-button epaulets, and a wide leather cummerbund-belt with a brass-ring buckle, over a white cotton shirt with linked copper collar-studs, pale canvas trousers tucked into low-heeled leather deck-boots, a brass spyglass on a leather fob.

A matte-black oilskin boarding-coat with heavy brass hook-and-eye closures and a reinforced leather collar, over a charcoal wool collarband shirt and a padded leather chest-protector with copper-rivet edging, twill trousers tucked into iron-toed boots, a bandolier of brass-capped grenades, leather gauntlets with brass knuckle-guards.

A smoke-grey Edwardian frock coat of worsted wool with silk-faced notch lapels and brass mourning-buttons, over a pale-blue high-collar shirt and a silver-thread waistcoat, charcoal breeches tucked into patent-leather boots, a leather dispatch-wallet on a brass-slide strap, copper-framed pince-nez on a fine brass chain.

A Qing-influenced sky-navigator's teal silk-and-wool changshan longcoat with frogged brass lotus-buttons and embroidered cloud-band cuffs, over a white collarband cotton shirt, straight trousers tucked into black leather boots with brass heel-caps, a wide leather waistband with brass compass-medallion clasp, leather wrist-guards riveted in copper.
